d: Namaste, Renault India recently launched its Duster Hybrid in the Indian market at a starting price of Rs 16.99 Lakh. With this launch, the Duster lineup is now almost complete, as two turbo petrol engines were already on sale, and the brand promised three, including this hybrid, when it announced the Duster last year. I recently drove the Duster Hybrid for quite sometime in both City and highways and here are my impressions about it.
